title: A Typical Safari Day, Hour by Hour
excerpt: From the wake-up call at dawn to dinner by the fire: what a typical day on safari in Tanzania looks like.
body:
Each safari day is different, but most follow a similar rhythm.

## 05:30–06:00 Wake-up

Coffee or tea, sometimes brought to your tent.

## 06:00–09:30 Morning drive

The coolest and often best part of the day.

## 09:30–10:30 Breakfast

Back at camp, or a picnic breakfast in the bush.

## Midday: rest

Rest, swim in the pool, read or watch animals at a waterhole near camp. In large parks you may stay out with a packed lunch.

## 13:00 Lunch

## 15:30–18:30 Afternoon drive

Back before dark, as many parks require vehicles to return before sunset.

## 19:00 Sundowner and dinner

A drink by the fire, stories of the day, dinner.

## Travel days

On travel days between parks, you do a game drive on the way.

## Your own pace

On a private safari, you decide. See [private or group safari](/blog/private-vs-group-safari/).

[Plan your safari](/travel-proposal/).
